On Tue, Jul 21, 2026 at 09:27 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Susan — thank you for the heads up and the logs. We're prioritizing this now.

Quick tech notes from the dive:
- Symptom: rapid increase in upstream 502/503 and a correlated spike in 5xx at our edge; clients are retrying aggressively which amplifies load.
- Likely root area: partial DNS propagation / routing flap with one of the customer's DNS providers (we see elevated NXDOMAIN / timeouts prior to the 502s in the trace). Some requests are being routed to an overloaded proxy cluster.

Immediate mitigations we recommend (can be done in parallel):
1) Client-side: ask RetailCorp to reduce retry attempts (we recommend backoff multiplier x2 and cap retries to 2 for 10 minutes).
2) Server-side: divert traffic for RetailCorp to a warmed fallback pool in us-west-2 while we isolate the bad proxy.
3) Traffic shaping: apply a short-term token bucket per-customer to limit retry amplification.

Commands / runbook pointers (ops):
- To add diversion rule: /ops/route set --account RC-3471 --pool fallback-us-west2
- To add rate limit: /ops/rate set --account RC-3471 --rps 30

Request from RetailCorp: logs from their LB (timestamps 08:40–09:10) and any client request IDs you can surface. I've attached a sample of our 5xx logs.

-Monica

Team / RetailCorp leaders,

Post incident summary (short):
- Impact window: 08:48–10:12 PDT (approx). Observed amplified 5xx/429 as a downstream DNS routing flap caused a subset of traffic to be routed to an overloaded proxy pool inside us-east-1. Client retries amplified the traffic leading to a retry storm.
- Mitigation: Ops applied a targeted token-bucket rate limit and diverted RetailCorp traffic to a warmed compatible pool in us-east-1 at 09:02. Error rates subsided by ~10:12.
- Root cause: partial DNS provider propagation + overloaded upstream proxy cluster; no code change on Redwood's control plane.

Customer asks:
- They are requesting a commercial credit for the impacted window and support to validate mobile SDK retry behavior across older app versions.

- Customer success ask: Marissa to run a hands-on SDK audit and patch roadmap with RetailCorp this week.

Supporting artifacts: routing-trace.txt, prod-errors-5xx-sample.log, mitigation-steps.md; PagerDuty incident PD-9043. HubSpot deal RC-3471 is updated with the incident note.
